account_created: Account created. From now on, sign in with your email and password.
session_expired: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
account_locked: Your account is temporarily locked after several failed attempts. Try again later.
account_inactive: Your account is not active. Contact your administrator.
access_key_invalid: The access key is not valid. Check it or ask Monkey for a new one.
access_key_already_used: This key was already used to create your company's account. Sign in with your email and password.
access_key_expired: The access key has expired. Ask Monkey for a new one.
access_key_email_mismatch: The email doesn't match the administrative email Monkey registered for your company.
email_taken: An account with that email already exists.
access_key_found: Valid key. Create your password to activate the account.
access_key_rate_limited: Too many attempts with the key. Wait a few minutes and try again.
mfa_required: The code from your authenticator app is missing.
mfa_setup_required: To protect your account, set up the second factor.
mfa_setup_started: Scan the code with your authenticator app.
mfa_enabled: Done, your account is protected. Keep your recovery codes safe.
mfa_challenge_invalid: Your verification expired or is no longer valid. Sign in again.
mfa_code_invalid: That code is not correct. Check it is the latest one in your app and try again.
mfa_setup_not_started: First scan the code to set up the second factor.
mfa_not_enabled: This account has no second factor yet.
mfa_recovery_regenerated: We generated new recovery codes. The old ones no longer work.
mfa_reset: We removed the second factor. The person will set it up again at their next sign-in.
